response.overview: After the sudden loss of his wife, Hilman travels to Sarawak in search of peace and a chance to clear his mind. Hosted by a relative he has never met before, the quiet getaway slowly becomes overshadowed by unsettling encounters and an increasing sense that something isn't quite right. As fragments of truth begin to surface, Hilman is forced to question his memories, his identity, and whether some things are meant to be forgotten.
response.title: Square One
